text.en: Clients consistently praise owners Lynn and Mark for their friendly, compassionate demeanour and genuine interest in building relationships with pet families. Reviewers who have visited the salon for years highlight their reliability and sincere warmth. Pet owners describe feeling completely comfortable entrusting their dogs to their care.

Dog owners note that pets are handled with thorough care, patience, and individual attention throughout their grooming sessions. Whether managing energetic spaniels or older pets, the groomers ensure that dogs remain calm and settled. Reviewers frequently remark that their dogs look happy and relaxed when collected after their appointment.

Reviewers express delight with the quality of grooming, noting that dogs emerge looking pristine, neatly trimmed, and smelling fresh. Multiple clients comment that the grooming finish lasts well and makes their pets look wonderful. The consistent craftsmanship keeps pet owners returning over many years without seeking other salons.

q.en: Who operates Collar and Tie Dog Groomers?

a.en: The salon is run by Lynn and Mark, who manage appointments personally with individual care for each dog.

q.en: How are anxious or sensitive dogs handled?

a.en: Reviewers note that the groomers take time to calm dogs, ensuring they remain relaxed and comfortable throughout the session.

q.en: Are the grooming results consistent across visits?

a.en: Long-standing clients report high consistency and neat styling results across years of regular appointments.
